description: National Earth System Science Data Center (国家地球系统科学数据中心) is a database run by Ministry of Science and Technology, China (national data centre network). The data centre is a national platform for earth-system science data, covering resources, environment, hydrology, geology, hazard and remote-sensing collections contributed by research institutes, with a search and request service. Coverage: China (national and regional collections). It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as geotiff, shp, csv; access is free of charge for most collections, with registration and request for downloads. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("国家地球系统科学数据中心首页") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support hazard and land-cover inputs for infrastructure studies in China. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
